auth.updateAttempts: UPDATE security.auth SET login_attempts = $2, login_until = $3 WHERE id = $1

info.getInfoByUsername: SELECT ai.* FROM security.auth_info AS ai INNER JOIN security.auth AS a ON ai.auth_id = a.id INNER JOIN security.users AS u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.username = $1
info.updatePassword: UPDATE security.auth_info SET password = $2 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING *

roles.getRolesWithCategories: SELECT r.id as role_id, r.name as role_name, rc.id as roles_categories_id, rc.name as roles_categories_name, r.description as role_description, r.is_special as role_is_special, r.created_at as role_created_at, r.updated_at as role_updated_at, r.deleted_at as role_deleted_at FROM security.roles AS r INNER JOIN security.roles_categories_roles AS rcr ON rcr.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN security.roles_categories AS rc ON rc.id = rcr.roles_categories_id
roles.getRolesByAuthId: SELECT r.name FROM security.roles AS r INNER JOIN security.auth_roles as ar ON ar.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN security.auth AS a ON a.id = ar.auth_id WHERE a.id = $1

sessions.deleteSession: DELETE FROM security.active_sessions WHERE id = $1 RETURNING *
sessions.deleteOtherSessions: DELETE FROM security.active_sessions WHERE id != $1 AND auth_id = $2

user.getUserByAuthId: SELECT * FROM security.users WHERE id = (SELECT user_id FROM security.auth WHERE id = $1)
user.updateUsername: UPDATE security.users SET username = $2 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING *
user.deleteUser: UPDATE security.users SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1

profile.updateDescription: UPDATE security.profile SET description = $2 WHERE user_id = $1 RETURNING *
profile.updateBirthDate: UPDATE security.profile SET birth_date = $2 WHERE user_id = $1 RETURNING *
profile.setCoverImage: UPDATE security.profile SET profile_image_id = $1 WHERE user_id = $2 RETURNING *
profile.setBackgroundImage: UPDATE security.profile SET background_image_id = $1 WHERE user_id = $2 RETURNING *

images.createRecord: INSERT INTO commons.images (url, images_store_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING *

stores.getAll: SELECT iis.*, p.name AS priority_name, p.priority AS priority, sn.name AS store_name, ss.name AS store_service_name FROM commons.images_store AS iis INNER JOIN commons.store_services AS ss ON iis.store_service_id = ss.id INNER JOIN commons.store_names AS sn ON sn.id = iis.store_name_id INNER JOIN commons.priorities AS p ON p.id = iis.priority_id
